description: Renders image, file, and generated stamp signing steps.

parameters.name: Field
parameters.description: Signing field represented by this step.

parameters.name: AllowMultiple
parameters.description: Whether file input allows multiple files.

parameters.name: AppearsOn
parameters.description: Short text describing where the field appears in the document.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the shell element.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.description: Culture used to resolve localized field text.

parameters.name: FallbackCulture
parameters.description: Fallback culture used when localized field text is missing.

parameters.name: StampValue
parameters.description: Generated stamp text or image identifier.
